Callout.Name: Armed Suspect Refusing to Comply
Callout.Message: Armed suspect refusing to comply, officers holding back.
Callout.Advisory: Suspect in a yard, weapon visible, no shots exchanged.

Script.Line: I am not putting it down until you back off.
I told you what I want and you were not listening.
You have got all night. So have I.

Lines.Approach: He will not put it down and he will not come out. Back-up is two minutes out.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
